title: 第3066章 巅峰隐秘六大层次临门一脚第3065章 大劫主计划二十阶巅峰的秘密
slug: 废武魂我逆天进化震惊世界
content_zh:
风祖深吸了一口气，目露向往之色。
“这二十阶巅峰的风景跟其他境界完全不同。”
“踏入二十阶巅峰，才算是真正开始走在追赶九维大界古老最强者们的道路上。”
“过去每一个九维大界的最强者，实力都在二十阶巅峰这个境界里面。”
“二十阶巅峰强者实力划分六个层次，更有说法是六个领域。”
“哦？”洛凡尘颇为感兴趣。
其实他很想知道，自己是媲美二十阶巅峰哪一个层次的高手。
风祖道：“二十阶巅峰第一个层次，也就是最常见的层次被誉为普通领域。”
“这个层次的高手在二十阶后期之时表现的就中规中矩，没有越级战斗的亮眼表现。”
洛凡尘点头，示意风祖继续。
“这二十阶巅峰的第二个层次是超强领域。”
“这个领域的强者足以碾压第一个层次的二十阶巅峰。”
“他们在二十阶后期的时候一般都是可以一个人战五六个同境界的存在，现有同境的对手存在。”
风祖继续道：“第三个层次就是顶尖了。”
“这个层次的高手在二十阶后期之时一般没有对手，似教主你收服的灰河古祖和邪藤古祖若是能突破到二十阶巅峰，便可拥有此等战力。”
众人看着洛凡尘的眼神在此刻变化。
他们突然想到，洛凡尘若是不突破则以，一旦突破那就是超越了二十阶巅峰第三个层次的大高手，无论是在黑暗天祖庙还是在大道共济会都有他一席之地。
“说了三个了，后三个层次呢？”洛凡尘询问。
风祖道：“黑暗天祖庙的十天祖，还有我……他们大道共济会的十圣尊，最弱的实力都有着超越顶尖层次的水平，达到了第四个层次，霸主领域。”
“最弱的天祖和圣尊都有着霸主层次的水平。”

洛凡尘恍然。
原来二十阶巅峰还有这么多弯弯绕绕存在。
“第五个层次是绝巅，在大道共济会只有排名在头两把交易的圣尊才拥有此等实力。”
“而黑暗天祖庙那边则有数个。”
“至于第六个层次，至强领域的强者，大道共济会则是一个都没有。”
“而此等实力的强者，黑暗天祖庙有两个。”
风祖等人提及此事之时就是一阵怯懦。
没办法，高端战力相差太大了，所以只能被动挨打。
“那么多的九维大界培养大劫主，就是希望能诞生出一尊在二十阶巅峰内至强层次的存在。”
洛凡尘唏嘘不已。
哪里想到一个二十阶巅峰，竟然还存在六个层次。
不过他倒是没觉得有什么。
毕竟一开始的目标就放在了对抗黑暗至高存在上。
洛凡尘忍不住问：“难道达到二十阶巅峰第六个层次以后，再突破就是二十一阶了？”
风祖等人连连摇头。
“不！”
“如今我们只知道这六个层次，是因为黑暗天祖庙那边有两个天祖远比我们第五个层次的圣尊强，所以才说的有第六个层次。”
洛凡尘笑了笑：“那我比祂们强，不就相当于第七个层次了？”
风祖等人唇角一抽，这……
哪有那么容易。

这家伙哪里来的迷之自信！
content_en:
Feng Zu took a deep breath, his eyes showing longing.
"The scenery at the peak of level 20 is completely different from other realms."
"Only when you reach the peak of level 20 can you truly begin to follow the path of catching up with the ancient and strongest people in the nine-dimensional world."
"Every strongest person in the nine-dimensional world in the past was at the peak of the twentieth level."
"The strength of the peak twenty-level experts is divided into six levels, or even six realms."
"Oh?" Luo Fanchen was quite interested.
In fact, he really wanted to know which level of master he was compared to the peak of level 20.
Feng Zu said: "The first level of the 20th level, which is the most common level, is known as the ordinary realm."
"The masters of this level perform quite well in the late twentieth level, and they don't have any outstanding performance in leapfrogging battles."
Luo Fanchen nodded and signaled Feng Zu to continue.
"The second level of this twenty-level peak is the super strong field."
"A strong person in this field is enough to crush the peak of the 20th level of the first level."
"When they are in the late twentieth level, they can usually fight five or six existences of the same realm by themselves. There are already opponents of the same realm."
Feng Zu continued: "The third level is the top."
"Masters at this level generally have no opponents at the late twentieth level. If the Gray River Ancestor and Evil Vine Ancient Ancestor whom you have conquered, Master, can have such combat power if they can break through to the peak of the twentieth level."
The eyes of everyone looking at Luo Fanchen changed at this moment.
They suddenly thought that if Luo Fanchen did not break through, once he broke through, he would be a great master who had surpassed the third level of the 20th level. He would have a place in both the Dark Heavenly Ancestral Temple and the Grand Avenue Freemasonry.
"I mentioned three, what about the last three levels?" Luo Fanchen asked.
Feng Ancestor said: "The Ten Heavenly Ancestors of the Dark Heavenly Ancestral Temple, and me...the Ten Saints of their Dao Freemasonry, the weakest ones have surpassed the top level, reaching the fourth level, the overlord field."
"The weakest Heavenly Ancestor and Holy Lord are both at the overlord level."
Luo Fanchen suddenly realized.
It turns out that there are still so many twists and turns at the peak of level 20.
"The fifth level is the pinnacle. Only the saints ranked in the first two trades in the Grand Avenue Freemasonry have such strength."
"And there are several over there at the Dark Heaven Ancestral Temple."
"As for the sixth level, the strongest person in the most powerful field, there is no one in the Avenue Freemasonry."
"And there are two powerful men of this level in the Dark Heaven Ancestral Temple."
When Feng Zu and others mentioned this matter, they felt cowardly.
There is no way, the high-end combat power is too different, so they can only be beaten passively.
"So many people from the Nine-Dimensional Realm cultivate the Great Tribulation Lord, hoping to give birth to a being who is at the strongest level within the peak of the 20th level."
Luo Fanchen sighed endlessly.
Who would have thought that there are still six levels of a twenty-level peak.
But he didn't think it was anything.
After all, the goal from the beginning was to fight against the supreme existence of darkness.
Luo Fanchen couldn't help but ask: "Could it be that after reaching the sixth level of the peak of the 20th level, you can break through to the 21st level?"
Feng Zu and others shook their heads repeatedly.
"No!"
"Now we only know these six levels. It's because there are two Heavenly Ancestors in the Dark Heavenly Ancestral Temple who are far stronger than our fifth-level Saints, so we talk about the sixth level."
Luo Fanchen smiled: "Then I am better than them, isn't it equivalent to the seventh level?"
Feng Zu and others twitched their lips, this...
It's not that easy.
Where does this guy get his incredible confidence?
